extracted.name: Herby baked fish with green olives
extracted.description: Use the extras from our summer bean stew as the base to make this dish with white fish in a herby topping, green olives and leftover green aïoli
ingredient_lines: small handful of soft herbs finely chopped (we used parsley and basil)
500g white fish loins (such as cod), cut into 4
leftover herby green aïoli (see recipe above)
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Tip the beans and a few ladlefuls of its broth into a large baking dish. Combine the oil, herbs, za’atar, olives and some seasoning in a bowl, and use this to coat the fish.

Arrange the fish over the beans and bake for 15-20 mins, depending on how thick the fish is, until the fish is cooked through and the beans are bubbling. Divide between four plates and top with a spoonful of aïoli.
